title: Local lifts for an epimorphism of etale sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, let $\Lambda$ be a ring, and let $0\to\mathcal M\to\mathcal E\xrightarrow{\pi}\mathcal N\to0$ be a short exact sequence of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every etale $X$-scheme $U$ and every section $t\in\mathcal N(U)$, there is an etale covering $(U_i\to U)_i$ and sections $s_i\in\mathcal E(U_i)$ with $\pi(s_i)=t|_{U_i}$.
